vibe: Professional, sterile, trustworthy, and actionable. Perfect for legal and case management platforms.

rules: No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use Manrope for a crisp, authoritative look.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large text (>= 24px).
Overlines and table headers MUST be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), and widely spaced (tracking-[0.15em]).
Tinted Neutral Greys: Rely on 'slate' rather than pure grey for a professional legal tone.
Avoid pastel backgrounds for main surfaces; use crisp white to ensure maximum readability of data.
Never use full-screen gradients in dashboards. Keep it flat, clean, and cardless where possible.

page_structure: Header Area: Contains the H1 ('Task Management' or 'Tareas'), global actions (Create Task Button).
Stats Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8. Flat solid cards with 1px border.
Filter Bar: Sticky horizontal bar or distinct section containing Shadcn Tabs (All, Mine, Created) and Select dropdowns (Status, Priority).
Task List: A dense, professional list-view (cardless table hybrid). Every row is a distinct item with a subtle 1px bottom border.
spacing: Use generous internal padding for sections (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside metric cards).
Ensure space between distinct dashboard modules (gap-8 or mb-8).

stats_cards.style: Neumorphic/Flat Hybrid. bg-white, 1px border-slate-200, no drop shadow. Rounded-xl.
stats_cards.content: Large metric number (text-4xl Manrope tracking-tight), small uppercase label, subtle icon in the top right corner.

task_list.style: Flat, cardless list. Each row has a hover effect (hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors duration-200).
task_list.priority_indicator: A 4px vertical border on the left edge of the task row (e.g., border-l-4 border-red-500 for High).
task_list.expansion: Clicking a row expands it down smoothly (using Shadcn Accordion pattern or Framer Motion). The expanded area should have a slightly different background (bg-slate-50) and an inset inner shadow or top/bottom borders to differentiate it from the main row list.

filters.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for switching views ('All', 'Mine', 'Created by me'). Style the active tab with a crisp underline or solid slate-900 background for high contrast.
filters.dropdowns: Use Shadcn Select for filtering Status. Ensure they don't have transparent backgrounds.

dialogs.create_task: Shadcn Dialog. Use Glassmorphism for the backdrop (backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-900/40) to keep focus on the modal. The modal itself must be solid bg-white with sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-xl).

components.status_dropdown: A small embedded Shadcn Select or DropdownMenu inside the task row to quickly change status without opening the full details.
components.comments_thread: Inside the expanded view. Display as a vertical timeline. Use a left border line (border-l-2 border-slate-200) to connect comments visually.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. They provide a precise, geometric look ideal for legal and dashboard applications. Install: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` or `npm install @phosphor-icons/react`
visual_enhancers.motion: Keep animations minimalist and snappy. 0.2s transitions for hover states. Accordion expansion should take 0.3s ease-out.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: If no tasks match a filter, display a structured empty state: Phosphor Icon (e.g., FileDashed), muted text, and a 'Clear Filters' button.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text on slate-900 must be pure white.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have a clear focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, filter tabs, rows, status dropdowns, submit buttons) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='filter-tab-mine'`, `data-testid='task-row-expand'`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use HTML-based components for complex interactions. Rely on Shadcn UI (Tabs, Select, Dialog, DropdownMenu).
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts for the main dashboard content. Use left-aligned grids.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).

For the Task List, avoid a basic HTML <table> if possible. Use a CSS Grid layout for rows (`grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-center`) to allow complex internal structures like the expandable comment section.
Use Phosphor icons. Do NOT use emojis as icons.
Ensure 'Tramilex' brand feels robust. Sharp lines, clear typography, and logical groupings of data.
Add toast notifications (using sonner) for actions like 'Task Created', 'Status Updated', or 'Comment Added'.
Since the target files are .js (AdminTareas.js), ensure React components are written in JS/JSX with PropTypes or jsdoc if needed, instead of TS interfaces.
